name: Goat The
overview: Scripture reveals that goats held a significant practical and symbolic role in the life of Israel, particularly in the construction of the tabernacle. The detailed account in Exodus 36 describes how goat hair was skillfully woven into eleven large curtains, coupled together with loops and brass taches to form a unified covering for the tabernacle. This highlights the value of goats not only as livestock but also as a source of essential materials for worship and the presence of God among His people.
